annotations.title: Where a brand sits against rivals

description: One brand's position at an airport this morning: its price index and rank on price, share of days it has the cheapest offer, customer rating and rank, each rating sub-score against the airport average, depot type, the rivals priced closest to it, and the brands that are rated higher while priced lower. Useful for positioning, a competitor review or a brand health check.

airport.description: IATA airport code, e.g. AKL, SYD, LHR, MAD. See list_airports.

brand.description: Brand name, partial match is fine, e.g. Hertz, Sixt, Europcar.

name: get_brand_position
